'''Rido-Attar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] who was born more than six hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Storyteller" /> Sometime before 4,243 BBY,<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} This article assumes that the Crew Skill missions occurred in 3643 BBY, but the actual date could be different. Adding six hundred years to 3643 BBY results in a date of 4,243 BBY.</ref> he embarked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning journey and did not return to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] until sometime during the Cold War, over six hundred years later.<ref name="Storyteller" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> he recounted stories and secrets of the heroes of the [[Jedi Civil War]] while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="Storyteller" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rido-Attar was first mentioned in the Archaeology Crew Skill mission "The Storyteller" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Storyteller" />
